sources.entry: Downright - Native macOS Markdown reader and editor for ordinary files, with Quick Look, Finder thumbnails, source-preserving rendering, and safe review of external rewrites.

summary.one_liner: Downright is a native macOS Markdown reader and editor that opens ordinary Markdown files in place, with Quick Look previews and Finder thumbnails.
summary.what_it_does: Opens Markdown files wherever they live on disk without a library or vault, and renders them as formatted documents using AppKit and TextKit 2. Editing works on the exact original source text, and a Document view and Source view share position and selection. It supports CommonMark and GitHub-flavored Markdown plus opt-in extensions such as math, Mermaid, tables, tasks, callouts, and footnotes. It tracks external changes to open files, preserves dirty local edits, and offers word-level review of external rewrites. It also includes local snapshots, a version timeline, HTML and PDF export, and a `down`/`md` command-line tool with commands like read, outline, export, check, and doctor.
use_cases: read and edit Markdown files on a Mac
preview Markdown files in Finder and Quick Look
review changes made to a file by another app or coding agent
export Markdown to HTML or PDF
inspect Markdown structure from the terminal
navigate long documents with outline and zoom
how_to_run: brew tap ezzy1630/downright && brew trust --cask ezzy1630/downright/downright && brew install --cask downright
git clone  (then) cd Downright && Scripts/bundle-xcode-app.sh && APP_SOURCE=.build-xcode/Build/Products/Release/Downright.app Scripts/install.sh
notable: Edits the exact source text on disk; rendering decorates the text storage rather than rewriting the file
Quick Look preview and Finder thumbnail extensions for Markdown files
Safe external-change tracking that preserves dirty local edits and allows word-level review
Offline, no account, no telemetry; optional on-device Apple Intelligence actions are off by default
Command-line tool `down` (alias `md`) with JSON output options for scripting
caveats: Full build requires Xcode and xcodegen; the Node-based installer is macOS-only and needs Node.js 18+
Memory target below 150 MB native session is stated as uncertified
